dialogue.origin: こんばんは
dialogue.content: Good evening.

dialogue.origin: こんばんわ。
dialogue.content: Good evening.

dialogue.origin: 本日の相談員です。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: I'm the counselor for today. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.origin: よろしくおねがいします。
dialogue.content: It's nice to meet you, too.

dialogue.origin: 少し早いですが始めますか？
dialogue.content: It's a bit early, but shall we begin?

dialogue.origin: はい。始めましょう。お願い致します。
dialogue.content: Yes. Let's begin. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: では、よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Alright, let's begin.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは、相談員です。今日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.content: Good evening, I'm the counselor. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 先日、友人の母から息子がひきこもりになって。。。と
dialogue.content: The other day, my friend's mother told me that her son has become a hikikomori...

dialogue.origin: 自分はどのようにしていけば良いかと
dialogue.content: And she asked me what I should do.

dialogue.origin: それは動揺しますよね？
dialogue.content: That must have been upsetting to hear, wasn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。
dialogue.content: Yes, it was.

dialogue.origin: そのお友達とは、どのような感じなんですか？
dialogue.content: What is your relationship with that friend like?

dialogue.origin: ここ1年ぐらいは連絡とってなかったんですが、半年前ぐらいに退職してから実家に帰って来てそのまま引きこもりがどんどん悪くなっている感じです。
dialogue.content: We hadn't been in touch for about a year, but I heard that about six months ago he quit his job, moved back to his parents' house, and his hikikomori state has been getting worse ever since.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね？
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そのようなご相談をうけると悩みますし、困りますよね？
dialogue.content: Being asked for advice on a situation like that must be worrying and difficult, right?

dialogue.origin: なんとかしたいのですが、いざどうするのが良いか分からなくて。。。
dialogue.content: I want to do something to help, but when it comes down to it, I just don't know what the best thing to do is.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: お友達の為にどうしたら良いのか迷いますよね？
dialogue.content: You’re unsure what would be helpful for your friend, right?

dialogue.origin: ええ。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ご自身は引きこもりについてはどのようにお考えですか？
dialogue.content: What are your own thoughts on hikikomori?

dialogue.origin: 引きこもりから脱却してほしいと思います。
dialogue.content: I want him to break out of it.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。。。
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: お友達のお子さんともご面識はあるのですか？
dialogue.content: Are you acquainted with your friend’s child as well?

dialogue.origin: 本人には子供はいないです。
dialogue.content: He doesn't have any children.

dialogue.origin: 友人が引きこもりで、その母から相談受けてます。わかりづらくてすみません。
dialogue.content: My friend is the one who's a hikikomori, and it's his mother who consulted me. I'm sorry if that was unclear.

dialogue.origin: ごめんなさい、勘違いしました。ご友人のお母さまからのご相談なのですね？
dialogue.content: I'm sorry, I misunderstood. So you were consulted by your friend's mother, is that right?

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ということは、お友達が引きこもりとなれば、かなりご心配の事と思います。
dialogue.content: In that case, with your friend being a hikikomori, I imagine you must be very worried.

dialogue.origin: はい。心配です。
dialogue.content: Yes. I am worried.

dialogue.origin: お母さまには何かお伝えしましたか？
dialogue.content: Have you told his mother anything so far?

dialogue.origin: どのようなことを伝えたらよいのか。。。
dialogue.content: I'm not sure what to say...

dialogue.origin: 今はお母さんの話を聞いていることが多いです。
dialogue.content: Right now, I mostly just listen to what his mother has to say.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。。。お母さまもお話しできることで少し楽にはなるかと思います。お優しいですね。。。
dialogue.content: I see... I imagine it's a bit of a relief for his mother just to have someone to talk to. That's very kind of you.

dialogue.origin: それしかできないので、、、でも、これからどうしたらよいか。。。
dialogue.content: It's the only thing I can do... but I don't know what to do from here...

dialogue.origin: そうですよね？お友達とのご関係者様をもう少しおはなしいただけますか？
dialogue.content: I understand. Could you tell me a bit more about the people around your friend?

dialogue.origin: 様は無しです。すいません
dialogue.content: Ah, my apologies for the awkward phrasing.

dialogue.origin: 現在は母と二人で住んでいます。一応仕事はあるようですが、週1回程度しか行けてない様子。
dialogue.content: Right now he lives with his mother, just the two of them. It seems he has a job, but he only manages to go about once a week.

dialogue.origin: 大体、昼過ぎに起床で、母が用意した食事を朝昼兼用と夕食はとっているようです。あとは、ほぼ自室にこもる感じです。
dialogue.content: He usually wakes up in the afternoon, and eats the meals his mother prepares for brunch and dinner. The rest of the time, he pretty much stays in his room.

dialogue.origin: そうですか。。。相談者様は、お友達とはどのようなご関係だったのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see... What was your relationship with your friend like?

dialogue.origin: 高校の同級生で同じ部活をしてました。
dialogue.content: We were high school classmates and in the same club.

dialogue.origin: 同じ時期を過ごされた大切な方なんですね？
dialogue.content: So he's a dear friend with whom you shared an important time in your life.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お母さまにお伝えするかはべつですが、お友達にお伝えしたい事やして差し上げたい事はありますか？
dialogue.content: Setting aside what you might tell his mother, is there anything you'd like to say or do for your friend?

dialogue.origin: 脱却してほしい。そのために、なにをするのが良いかが。。。どの様に声をかけてよいのか。。。
dialogue.content: I want him to break free from this. But I don't know what to do to help... or how I should even talk to him...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 以前の健全な状態とはだいぶ違うので、、、
dialogue.content: He's so different from the healthy person he used to be...

dialogue.origin: お母さまからはどのような説明を受けていますか？他に。。。ありますか？
dialogue.content: What kind of explanation have you received from his mother? Is there... anything else?

dialogue.origin: 高校の時はチームでキャプテンをしていて頼りがいのある人でした。仕事でも大企業の出世頭でした。
dialogue.content: In high school, he was the team captain and someone you could rely on. At work, too, he was a rising star at a major company.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 母がなんとかいろいろされてきたが、少し対立のような状況になっています。
dialogue.content: His mother has been trying various things to help, but it's led to a bit of a confrontational situation between them.

dialogue.origin: すれは、どうお声がけしたら良いか余計に悩みますよね？
dialogue.content: That must make it even harder to know what to say to him, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。
dialogue.content: Exactly.

dialogue.origin: なんでもおできになったのなら、プライドもおありかと。。。
dialogue.content: If he was someone who could do anything, he must have a lot of pride...

dialogue.origin: 常に人よりも優れていて、頼りにされる立場だったので、プライドは非常にあると思います。
dialogue.content: He was always more capable than others and in a position to be relied on, so I think he has a great deal of pride.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。。。
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: なので、間違った声掛けをしてしまうと、殻が分厚くなってしまいそうで。。。
dialogue.content: So, I'm afraid that if I say the wrong thing, he'll just retreat further into his shell...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: では、少しお話を振り返らせて頂いてよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Then, may I briefly summarize what I’ve heard?

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 高校時代に部活でご一緒に過ごされたお友達のお母さまから、引きこもりのご相談を受けて
dialogue.content: You’ve been consulted by the mother of a friend you were in a club with in high school about his being hikikomori,

dialogue.origin: 何とお声がけしたら良いか悩んでおられる。
dialogue.content: and you’re struggling with what to say to him.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: その方はリーダーシップをとるような出来る方なのでお声がけの内容には余計に気を使うので悩んでおられるのですね？
dialogue.content: Because he's a capable person who used to be a leader, you're being extra careful about what you say, and that's why you're struggling.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 相談者さまは、元気な以前のお友達をご存知ですし、復活してほしいと思っておられるんですよね？
dialogue.content: You knew your friend when he was well, and you want him to get back to his old self, right?

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: とてもお友達おもいの優しい方だと思います。
dialogue.content: I think you're a very kind and caring friend.

dialogue.origin: もう一つお聞きしたいのですが
dialogue.content: One more question, if I may.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お友達とは何でも屈託なく話せるなかでしたか？
dialogue.content: Were you able to talk openly about anything with your friend?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: では、ご提案なのですが、
dialogue.content: In that case, may I offer a suggestion?

dialogue.origin: そのようなお友達だったということなら、貴方のことを本当に大好きで、信頼しているということをお伝えしてみたらいかがでしょう？
dialogue.content: If that's the kind of friend he was, how about trying to tell him that you really care about him and trust him?

dialogue.origin: 伝えてはみます。
dialogue.content: I’ll try to tell him that.

dialogue.origin: ただ、向こうが受け入れられる状況かが自信ないです。
dialogue.content: I’m just not confident he’s in a place where he can accept it.

dialogue.origin: すこし違うかんじなんですね？
dialogue.content: So the situation is a little different now?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。昔の強い人ではなく、いまはどちらかというとすごく痛んで弱っているきがするので。
dialogue.content: Right. He’s not the strong person he used to be; if anything, he seems very hurt and weakened now.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。。。
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: お会いするのは無理そうですか？
dialogue.content: Does it seem difficult to meet in person?

dialogue.origin: 電話には、何とかたまに出るような状況ですかね。会うのはちょっとハードルが高いです。
dialogue.content: He does manage to answer the phone sometimes. Meeting up is a bit of a high hurdle.

dialogue.origin: そうなると、ただただ寄り添う、あるいは確信に触れずに楽しい雰囲気をつくるところから始めてみたらいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: In that case, how about starting by just being there for him, or trying to create a pleasant atmosphere without touching on the core issue?

dialogue.origin: それならいいような気がします。
dialogue.content: That feels like it could be good.

dialogue.origin: 少しずつが基本ですよね？
dialogue.content: Taking it one small step at a time is the basic principle, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: 少しづつですよね。
dialogue.content: One step at a time, right.

dialogue.origin: とにかく心を開いてもらうことに焦点をあててみてください。
dialogue.content: For now, please try to focus on just getting him to open up his heart.

dialogue.origin: 遠いですが、それが一番の方法かもしれないですね。
dialogue.content: It feels like a long road, but that might be the best way.

dialogue.origin: お仕事に行けるようになる事を急がせずに、寄り添って差し上げてみてはいかがでしょうか？相談者さまの優しいお気持ちが、伝わって元気になる日がきっと来ると信じていますよ。
dialogue.content: How about trying to be there for him without rushing him to get back to work? I believe that your kind feelings will get through to him, and the day will surely come when he feels better.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。焦らずに、そばで寄り添うがいいような気がします。
dialogue.content: You're right. I feel like it would be best to stay by his side without rushing things.

dialogue.origin: 頑張ってくださいね。応援しています！
dialogue.content: Please hang in there. I’m rooting for you!

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: まだまだ解決までにはありそうですが、今日のところはこれで終わりで大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.content: It seems there's still a ways to go for a resolution, but is it alright if we end here for today?

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫です。焦らずに、頑張ります。
dialogue.content: Yes, it's fine. I'll take it slow and do my best.

dialogue.origin: はい。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Yes. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: はい！きっと大丈夫ですよ。今日はご相談くださりありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Yes! I'm sure it will be alright. Thank you for coming to talk with me today.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、ありがとうござました。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well.

dialogue.origin: 終わりますね。不慣れですいません。またよろしくお願いいたしますね。
dialogue.content: We'll end here then. I apologize if I seemed inexperienced. I look forward to speaking with you again.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: I look forward to it.

topic.sub: 友人の引きこもりに対する支援方法
